payload.title: Cognitive Debt section
payload.description:
Ryan's description of the new anth.us section: "Cognitive Debt" is about humans struggling to keep up with the mountains of code that AI can now generate, and how that is becoming a bigger problem than writing the code.

First accepted source: https://www.oreilly.com/radar/agentic-code-review/ (O'Reilly Radar, "Agentic Code Review"). Ryan accepted it as a ground-truth label for the Anth.us newsroom, with no section assigned because the section does not exist yet.

Scope of this story: define and build the section. Not started; this story only records the focus and the first source.
